units.leftText: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
units.rightText: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
units.rightText: We are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;
leftNotes: 1:3 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

units.leftText: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
units.rightText: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;

units.leftText: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
units.rightText: which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

units.leftText: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
units.rightText: if so be that it is a righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,

units.leftText: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
units.rightText: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,

units.leftText: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
units.rightText: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:

units.leftText: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
units.rightText: who shall suffer punishment, even eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

units.leftText: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
units.rightText: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.

units.leftText: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
units.rightText: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and every work of faith, with power;

units.leftText: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
units.rightText: Now we beseech you, brethren, touching the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him;

units.leftText: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
units.rightText: to the end that ye be not quickly shaken from your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by epistle as from us, as that the day of the Lord is just at hand;

units.leftText: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
units.rightText: let no man beguile you in any wise: for it will not be, except the falling away come first, and the man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition,

units.leftText: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
units.rightText: he that opposeth and exalteth himself against all that is called God or that is worshipped; so that he sitteth in the temple of God, setting himself forth as God.

units.leftText: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
units.rightText: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

units.leftText: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
units.rightText: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

units.leftText: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
units.rightText: For the mystery of lawlessness doth already work: only there is one that restraineth now, until he be taken out of the way.

units.leftText: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
units.rightText: And then shall be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus shall slay with the breath of his mouth, and bring to nought by the manifestation of his coming;

units.leftText: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
units.rightText: even he, whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

units.leftText: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
units.rightText: and with all deceit of unrighteousness for them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

units.leftText: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
units.rightText: And for this cause God sendeth them a working of error, that they should believe a lie:

units.leftText: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
units.rightText: that they all might be judged who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

units.leftText: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
units.rightText: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, for that God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

units.leftText: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: whereunto he called you through our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
units.rightText: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.

units.leftText: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
units.rightText: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

units.leftText: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
units.rightText: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.

units.leftText: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
units.rightText: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as also it is with you;

units.leftText: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
units.rightText: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for all have not faith.

units.leftText: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
units.rightText: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

units.leftText: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
units.rightText: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command.

units.leftText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
units.rightText: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

units.leftText: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
units.rightText: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which they received of us.

units.leftText: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
units.rightText: For yourselves know how ye ought to imitate us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

units.leftText: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
units.rightText: neither did we eat bread for nought at any man’s hand, but in labor and travail, working night and day, that we might not burden any of you:

units.leftText: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
units.rightText: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you, that ye should imitate us.

units.leftText: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
units.rightText: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, If any will not work, neither let him eat.

units.leftText: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
units.rightText: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.

units.leftText: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
units.rightText: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

units.leftText: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
units.rightText: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well-doing.

units.leftText: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
units.rightText: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

units.leftText: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
units.rightText: And yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

units.leftText: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
units.rightText: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

units.leftText: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
units.rightText: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

units.leftText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
units.rightText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
